note: Set A correctly binds most dimensions and sections to their specific beam details (e.g., distinguishing W10X15 for B1 and W8X13 for E6 implicitly via opening type). Set B makes critical errors swapping section types (claiming B1 is W8X13 and E6 is W10X15, while the text shows the reverse) and misattributes dimensions (assigning B4's 5'-0" length to Grid 4). Set A has minor interpretation errors (e.g., labeling a 2" edge distance as flange width), but Set B's errors are direct contradictions of the text layer.
